text:
Fiona: tiny life update — promoted to Staff PM yesterday and also got engaged on Saturday! 🥂💍 thinking pizza slices + a short toast in the kitchen this Thu at 5:30pm. who can make it?
Gabe: OMG huge congrats!!! bringing pizza is my love language. what toppings should I order? :pizza:
Lola: congrats fiona!! 5:30 works for me. two pies veg please. I can do a tiny banner.
Rene: massive congrats 🎉 i'll bring sparkling cider (non-alc).
Sam: congrats!! I can handle a card + group gift collection: https://forms.gle/fiona-gift (short link). putting a couple of contribution tiers.
celebrate-bot: Proposed event: "Fiona: promo + engagement pizza" Thu 5:30 PM · Office Kitchen. React with :thumbsup: to join.
Jun: :thumbsup: remote but I can hop in for 10 minutes and throw confetti GIFs. send pics pls.
Priya: congrats!! do you have a registry link or is it just cards?
Fiona: registry (totally optional): https://zola.com/fiona-and-ali — honestly your faces are the gift. ❤️
Gabe: my vote: one margherita, one vegan pesto with tofu. extra olives for the haters.
Rene: i'll do dairy-free option and napkins/plates.
Lola: putting down paper confetti only (no poppers indoors!). also i'll bring a small chalk sign that says "Congrats Fiona".
Sam: RSVP form updated and I'll drop the physical card at reception on Friday.
Fiona: thank you all so much, this means a lot. see you Thursday — pizza and tiny toasts! 
Gabe: pics are required. also cake if someone wants to bring it.
Jun: dropping a ridiculous wedding-congrats GIF now :confetti_ball: :tada:
celebrate-bot: Event created: "Fiona: promo + engagement pizza" Thu 5:30 PM · Office Kitchen. Invites sent to team@redwood.com
Sam: added to calendar. congrats again!!
